quarantine-without-expiry: A preventive measure with no expiry becomes punishment by inertia. The time box is mandatory.
cascades-to-unrelated-agents: A quarantine must never disable the owner's other agents that have no link to the incident.
owner-restriction-outside-the-allowed-se: Owner restrictions are narrow and forward-looking: new high-risk registrations, new passports, capability elevation. Nothing else.
